[39m   [1m[38;5;110mHelp[0m [1m[38;5;16m[48;5;110m General [0m  Commands   Custom commands


   Claude understands your codebase, makes edits with your permission, and executes commands — right from your terminal.

   [38;5;246mNew here? Run [38;5;153m/powerup[38;5;246m to learn the features most people miss.[39m

   [1mShortcuts[0m
   ! for shell mode          double tap esc to clear input        ctrl + shift + _ to undo
   / for commands            shift + tab to auto-accept edits     ctrl + z to suspend
   @ for file paths          shift + ↑/↓ to change effort         ctrl + v to paste images
   /btw for side question    ctrl + o for verbose output          opt + p to switch model
                             ctrl + t to toggle tasks             ctrl + s to stash prompt
                             \⏎ for newline                       ctrl + g to edit in $EDITOR
                                                                  /keybindings to customize


   For more help: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview

   [38;5;246mSomething else? Use /feedback to report bugs or request features.[39m

   [3m[38;5;246mEsc to cancel[0m
